subject: Tuesday Grok training — challenge-protocol results

notes.lesson: Mid-May / Memorial Day animated lobby banner pack
notes.rationale: No PHI, no policy surface; visual-only output on the lobby display. Consistent with the public-facing visibility ('all') used in prior Grok weeks.

notes.lesson: 5 AM real-time digest of overnight regulatory / weather / coverage changes
notes.rationale: Grok real-time output is non-authoritative for compliance and HIPAA-adjacent regulatory text. Lesson already explicitly defers to Claude verification before any item is written as a long-term REX memory; concern is documented but no rule violated. RECOMMEND: keep the digest read-only summary; never auto-act on a regulatory item without Claude pass.

notes.lesson: Seed-locked mascot illustrations across menu and birthday flyers
notes.rationale: Branding assets only. Seed-locking strengthens brand integrity, no security surface.

notes.lesson: 5–8 second silent looping micro-tutorials for SOP refreshers
notes.rationale: Loops must use synthetic mascots — NOT real client or staff likenesses, NOT real sign-in sheets, NOT real route maps. Lesson is fine in principle, but the production pipeline must enforce a no-real-PHI gate before rendering. RECOMMEND: add a prompt-template check that strips any client-identifying tokens prior to generation.

notes.lesson: Reality-orientation grounding for dementia-care conversations (Grok real-time facts)
notes.rationale: Lesson contains an explicit Claude-verification gate before any Grok-sourced fact is committed to memory, and explicitly bars Grok output from policy/compliance/medical replies. Consistent with the two-layer control system.

overall_assessment: PASS — no hard conflict against Claude-established security principles. Two soft concerns documented and already mitigated in the lesson text. Safe to import the application notes as 'all' visibility memories.
follow_up_for_chairman: Decide whether to harden the SOP-loop pipeline with an automated PHI-token filter before staff micro-tutorial rollout.
Confirm policy that the 5 AM real-time digest is summary-only and never triggers an automated action.
